title: Austin: Homelessness Coalition Meeting
summary:
*   City leaders attended the Ending Community Homelessness Coalition (ECHO) fall meeting.
*   The primary focus of the gathering was addressing homelessness within the Austin community.
*   While a quorum of Council members may have been present for discussion, no official actions or votes were taken at this event.
